verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Vapi exposes its own APIs as an MCP server (so external MCP clients like Claude Desktop can control Vapi), but this is the opposite direction from the story — there's no evidence that Vapi assistants can consume/plug-in external MCP servers to use their tools within a conversation. Vapi's tool docs describe webhook-based custom tools and OpenAI-style function calling only, with no mention of MCP-server ingestion.
